# Whole-site Review Mirror

This is the temporary, static, plaintext, LLM-readable projection of the useful public jobsearch site information.
Use these ordinary WWW pages rather than GitHub repository/API/MCP access when reviewing published content.

## Main surfaces

- Site overview: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/
- Jobs: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/jobs/
- Employer Landscape: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/employers/
- Curated Companies dossiers: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/companies/
- Automation/status: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/automation/
- SysMap: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/sysmap/
- RF + ADJ employer corpus: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/model/rf-adj/index.html
- Employer RF + ADJ filter: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/filters/rf-adj.html
- Employer RF-only filter: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/filters/rf.html
- Matches: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/matches/

## Machine-readable entry points

- Whole-site manifest: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/model/site/manifest.json
- Jobs manifest: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/model/jobs/manifest.json

## Snapshot

- Allow-listed jobs: 2
- Curated Companies dossiers: 15

Employer pages contain the systematic canonical identity, descriptions, relevance, careers research, current researched roles, organisation assessment and Match/resonator projection where available.
Companies pages contain the separate manually curated dossier material and should not be treated as interchangeable with the systematic Employer Landscape.
Jobs pages contain the allow-listed published job-information cards.
Automation and SysMap pages expose their existing public-safe published projections in directly readable form.

All substantive review pages are static HTML or JSON. No JavaScript loader, encrypted payload, runtime API or browser unlock is required.
